title: mqttlib
description: A Dependency for NeoForge Mods that require MQTT
body:
Currently Required by Following Mods:
  EndrocityClient for NeoForge

Unlike Fabric, Neoforge has somewhat of a problem with importing external dependencies due to which the dependency has to be made into a jar of itself so we can use Jar in Jar to get stuff like MQTT working in Neoforge
